description: Brought their last day, the hampers, and a rumour, and no receipt.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Said Bankside has nowhere else of an afternoon, and that nothing came back.
name: John Heminges

description: Said she would as soon they had somewhere.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Said they have run, and made no jest of it.
name: Will Kemp

description: Asked for the rest, refused a sum, and said the letter was not about this day.
name: William Shakespeare
